# Third-Party

Empty by default. When you start using someone else's skill and want a recovery copy of it, this is where it goes.

Copy in the skill's source folder as-is, including its own LICENSE and README, rather than just the parts you use. Check what the license actually permits before you rely on it; even a permissive license such as MIT requires the original copyright notice to travel with any copy you keep.

Add a row to `00_Skills/Skills Inventory.md` for anything you place here.
